bio: This lakeside inn overlooking Tegernsee is picture perfect; in summer, the terrace is the stuff of dreams. The interior is especially inviting, with cosy dining spaces done out in warm wood. The menu features delicious regional classics such as roast pork with dumplings or locally caught char with parsley potatoes, as well as more upscale fare such as turbot fillet with pumpkin risotto. The service is friendly and efficient, and the staff are all dressed in traditional Bavarian attire. Gorgeous suite on the top floor....
